## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the small rounded plastic mouse and set it on the Green mat.

Task description: Pick up the small rounded plastic mouse at the front left of the table, place it on the green rectangular mat behind it, and adjust its orientation.

Success criteria: Lay the mouse flat near the green mat's center with its long axis approximately along the mat's long dimension. Both grippers must be open and release it. Resting only on the edge or lying crosswise does not count.

## Execution tips

- Approach from above if possible, gripping the shell’s flatter side walls around the middle with the fingers across its short axis. Set the opening slightly wider than that area to avoid pressing only on the dome or slipping off the narrower end.
- Before closing, use the live view to confirm the fingers are on opposite sides of the housing and the pads have enough contact area. If only the fingertips touch the upper edge, adjust the grasp height to avoid hitting the table.
- When adjusting the long-axis orientation, rotate in an open area clear of the table and avoid the black object to the left of the green mat, reducing fingertip contact with the table and gripper collisions.
- During placement, release only after the mouse is supported by the mat. Open the gripper enough for the pads to clear the shell and withdraw easily, avoiding sliding the mouse or moving it with the retreating gripper.
